findings.title: the borrowed-caller-pointer fix is faithful to key_event.zig:103-111, BUT its two new proving tests are Stacked-Borrows UB and turn the G6 Miri lane RED (retag from a SharedReadOnly tag invalidated by a later write; raised at key_event.rs:106 slice::from_raw_parts inside sync_utf8)

batches.note: The production behavior is correct and must be preserved (the C ABI genuinely borrows the caller's pointer, matching the oracle). The defect is that the TESTS create the aliasing pattern in a way Miri rejects. Follow the repo's raw-pointer aliasing doctrine: route the mutation through the alias's own pointer rather than through a &mut that invalidates it. Requirement: 'cargo +nightly miri test -p rustty-vt-c --lib' must be clean (that crate is a gated Miri lane per .port/tools/gates/check_leaks.sh) while both tests still prove the caller-pointer semantics.
